seo.title: Passenger Boat & Speedboat Design | Lasan Marine Co., Ltd.
seo.description: Design of passenger boats, tourist speedboats and inland vessels: seating, stability with passengers crowding, life-saving equipment and approval documents.

fields.headline: Passenger boats, tourist speedboats and inland vessels
fields.lead: A passenger boat is about safety first: stability when passengers crowd one side, enough life-saving equipment and sensible escape routes — designed to pass review and earn its keep.

items.context: Fast, comfortable, carrying the licensed number of passengers.
items.solution: Planing lines, seating layout, stability and engine choice for the service speed.
Arrangement, crowding stability, safety and escape.

fields.heading: What you receive
fields.intro: A full design set for building and approval.
fields.note: Lead time is agreed with the quote, depending on vessel type, scope and existing documents. You know each delivery date in advance.

items.title: Safety and life-saving equipment
items.desc: Matched to rules and passenger count

steps.title: Send us the brief
steps.desc: Vessel type, target dimensions, operating area and any photos or documents you have.

steps.title: Scope and quote
steps.desc: We agree the scope, deliverables and schedule, with a clear price for each part.

steps.title: Design and calculations
steps.desc: Drawings and calculations with industry software and our own engineering tools.

steps.title: Review and handover
steps.desc: We answer the reviewer’s comments, update the documents and hand over the final set.

items.title: What matters most in passenger boat design?
items.content: Stability with passengers on one side, life-saving equipment for the passenger count, and escape routes — the points reviewers check most closely.

fields.heading: Need a passenger boat?
fields.description: Call us with the passenger count, route and target speed. We propose a suitable concept.
